Lina: Quick sync 1: we need a short technical SEO checklist for the benchmark launch + webinar. Keywords, JSON-LD, redirects, internal links, UTMs. Who owns what?
Omar: I50D Ill do keywords + meta titles/descriptions. Will prioritize intent (informational -> TOFU). Deliver by EOD.
Gabe: Ill own UTMs + HubSpot mapping. Need the final landing slug and form id. Proposed utm_campaign=bench_launch_may.
Nina: Eng can implement redirects and check previews. site-bot: preview-check: social card 404 for /webinar/bench-latency. @nina please triage.
Lina: Two urgent bits: 1) 301 redirects for legacy /bench-* pages; 2) JSON-LD for Event + Article. Also make sure OG image and twitter:card meta are present.
Omar: Draft JSON-LD snippets (use as base):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Article","headline":"Redwood Inference: Latency & Cost Benchmarks","datePublished":"2026-05-10"}
```
and Event:
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Latency & Cost Benchmarks: Live Webinar","startDate":"2026-05-18T11:00:00-07:00","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/bench-latency"}
```
Nina: For redirects, example nginx rule I can deploy:
```nginx
# redirect legacy bench pages -> canonical blog
rewrite ^/bench/(.*)$ /blog/latency-bench permanent;
```
Gabe: UTM plan: utm_source=newsletter|linkedin, utm_medium=email|social, utm_campaign=bench_launch_may, utm_content=A|B. I'll add hidden fields to HubSpot form.
Lina: Internal links: add CTAs from product docs and 3 older posts (/posts/early-bench, /posts/mini-test, /posts/bench-draft). Omar can add rel=canonical and rel=prev/next on paginated series.
site-bot: staging-preview created at https://staging.redwood.ai/webinar/bench-latency-preview (expires in 72h).
Omar: I'll upload keyword doc + meta table: https://docs.google.com/document/d/keywords-bench-draft
Gabe: Tracking sheet uploaded: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/utm-bench-tracking

- Keyword priorities + meta -> Omar (EOD)
- JSON-LD Article + Event -> Omar (tomorrow AM)
- Redirect ticket + nginx -> Nina (MARK-5001) + eng (implement)
- Internal CTAs -> Content + Docs (add links by EOD)
